levels.full: Works as written on that host.
levels.partial: Works on that host with the limit stated in the note.
levels.no: Does not work on that host; the note says why.

hosts.claude_code: Claude Code (CLI, desktop and IDE extensions), running on your computer.
hosts.claude_app: The Claude app (claude.ai) with an uploaded skill; it runs in a remote sandbox with no access to your local files, repo or local shell.
hosts.codex: Codex (CLI, IDE extension and app), running on your computer.
hosts.chatgpt: Skills in ChatGPT; they run in a remote sandbox with no access to your local files, repo or local shell, and network access depends on the workspace settings and is not guaranteed.
hosts.other: Local agents that read SKILL.md folders: Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, OpenCode, Cline and others.
